verdict: Leads are up and cost-efficient; pipeline and tracking gaps need closing.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 138 leads at a cost of $15.85 per lead, and the most recent 7 days show that momentum is building — lead volume up 8% and cost per lead down slightly week-over-week. Meta is driving all attributed leads; Google Ads spent $507 this period but conversion tracking is not recording results, so that spend is currently running without measurable return — the tracking fix is in motion. Inside the pipeline, 132 opportunities were created from those leads but zero have been marked won and no appointments are logged, pointing to a routing gap between intake and follow-up that is being addressed. Expect cleaner attribution and a tighter pipeline view once tracking and intake fixes are confirmed live by end of September.
